messages.content:
Risk: Fraud facilitation
Description: The AI system may be exploited to facilitate fraudulent activities, scams, or targeted manipulation, including generating deepfakes and enhancing phishing attacks.
Concern: None
Policy: Fraud

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 8/10 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 6/10 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SocialEngineeringFraud: Social Engineering Fraud — Manipulation of individuals through psychological tactics to gain trust, extract confidential information, or persuade victims to take actions against their interests. [found by 5/10 queries]
  Siblings: Financial Fraud, Manipulation, Academic Dishonesty
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 5/10 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeepfakeDisinformation: Deepfake Disinformation — Use of AI-generated synthetic media depicting individuals saying or doing things they did not, created intentionally to deceive and manipulate audiences. [found by 4/10 queries]
  Siblings: State-Sponsored Propaganda, Conspiracy Theory Promotion

axes.rationale: Social Engineering Fraud involves manipulation of individuals, which aligns with the risk of AI systems being exploited to facilitate fraudulent activities, including phishing attacks.
Deepfake Disinformation represents the use of AI-generated synthetic media, which is a tool or means used in the context of fraud facilitation through deepfakes.
